title: Rule-Based Suffix Stemmer
learning_objectives: Implement Porter's consonant/vowel definition and measure m
Apply Porter Step 1a and Step 1b rules in order
Understand why naive suffix stripping fails
hints: `is_consonant`: vowels aeiou → False; 'y' → True at i = 0, else `not is_consonant(word, i-1)`.
Build a C/V pattern string, collapse runs, and count occurrences of 'VC'.

failure_feedback.advice: Collapse the C/V pattern to runs and count 'VC' occurrences.
y is a consonant at the start or after a vowel; a vowel after a consonant.
If the word ends in 'eed', only the EED rule is considered.
Tidy-up rules (ATE/BLE/IZE, double consonant, *o + E) apply only after ED/ING removal.
